description: Flat metadata schema for individual urban air sample records linked to metagenomic sequencing and environmental context.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air sample record.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS) or nearest available resolution.

time_zone.descr: Time zone of collection site/time, e.g., UTC, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo.

city.descr: City where the air sample was collected.

country.descr: Country where the air sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Name or label of the sampling site, e.g., downtown street, rooftop station, park edge.

site_type.descr: Categorical sampling environment, e.g., roadside, residential, industrial, park, rooftop, transit hub.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

altitude_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level in meters.

sampling_height_m.descr: Height above ground where the air sampler inlet was positioned, in meters.

sampling_duration_min.descr: Total active sampling time in minutes.

sampling_volume_m3.descr: Total air volume sampled, in cubic meters.

sampler_model.descr: Air sampling instrument/model used for collection.

sampler_flow_rate_l_min.descr: Air flow rate during sampling in liters per minute.

filter_or_collection_medium.descr: Type of filter, membrane, cartridge, or other collection medium used to capture airborne material.

weather_condition.descr: Dominant weather condition at sampling time, e.g., clear, cloudy, rain, fog, snow.

air_temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time as a percentage (0-100).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time in meters per second.

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction in degrees from north (0-360).

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation amount during the sampling period in millimeters.

atmospheric_pressure_hpa.descr: Atmospheric pressure at sampling time in hectopascals (hPa).

particulate_matter_pm1_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM1 in micrograms per cubic meter, if measured.

particulate_matter_pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic meter, if measured.

particulate_matter_pm10_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM10 in micrograms per cubic meter, if measured.

pollution_index.descr: Local air pollution index or air quality index value recorded at sampling time, if available.

human_activity_level.descr: Categorical estimate of nearby human activity during sampling, e.g., low, moderate, high, very_high.

traffic_intensity.descr: Traffic level near the site during sampling, e.g., none, low, moderate, high, severe.

sample_replicate_number.descr: Replicate number for the sampling event at this site and time.

field_blank_included.descr: Whether a field blank/control sample was collected alongside the air sample.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample was stored prior to extraction, in degrees Celsius.

time_to_extraction_h.descr: Elapsed time between collection and nucleic acid extraction, in hours.

nucleic_acid_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for nucleic acid extraction from the collected material.

dna_concentration_ng_ul.descr: DNA concentration after extraction in nanograms per microliter.

rna_concentration_ng_ul.descr: RNA concentration after extraction in nanograms per microliter, if applicable.

library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used for sequencing library construction.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used, e.g., shotgun metagenomic, paired-end, single-end, long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for short-read sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for the sample.

raw_data_file_name.descr: Name of the raw sequence data file associated with this sample, e.g., FASTQ file name.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name and/or version of the analysis pipeline used for processing sequence data.

taxonomic_reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic classification, e.g., SILVA, GTDB, Kraken database, if applicable.

notes.descr: Free-text notes about unusual conditions, deviations from protocol, or site-specific observations.
